message:
feat(packages/excalidraw): support onDuplicate replacements, vetoes and lookups (#12124)

feat(packages/excalidraw): make `onDuplicate` changes stick, support veto & lookups

The editor kept working with the duplicates it created after calling
`props.onDuplicate`, so a host returning new objects for them detached
them from the frame assignment and bound text redraw on paste, and from
the alt-drag handover.

- Add `reconcileDuplicatedElements()` and use it in all three duplication
  paths (paste/library insert, duplicate action, alt-drag). Elements the
  host returns for duplicates are shallow-merged into the editor's own
  objects (omitted properties are kept), invalidating what may have been
  cached for them by then (shape, bounds). Other returned elements keep
  the replace semantics.
- Omitting a duplicate (or returning it as deleted) vetoes it. So does
  returning `false` for the duplication as a whole. Bound text goes with
  its vetoed container, and references to vetoed duplicates are cleared
  from the remaining ones (as in `fixDuplicatedBindingsAfterDuplication`).
  If no duplicate remains the duplication is cancelled: paste and the
  action do nothing, alt-drag keeps moving the originals. On a partial
  veto during alt-drag the vetoed originals are left behind.
- On paste, resolve the target frame (and the z-order under it) before the
  callback, so that the host sees the duplicates the way they end up in
  the scene, and a vetoed duplicate isn't brought back.
- Pass lookups covering just the participating elements as a third
  argument: `duplicateElements`, `originalElements`, `origIdToDuplicateId`
  and `duplicateIdToOrigId`.

Claude Fable 5.1
